# gramstolbs.com

> A grams to pounds converter. Results are given in decimal pounds, in pounds with
> ounces, and in total ounces. One international avoirdupois pound is exactly
> 453.59237 grams (International Yard and Pound Agreement, 1959).

## Converters
- [Grams to Lbs](https://gramstolbs.com/): convert grams to pounds, pounds and ounces, and total ounces.
- [Lbs to Grams](https://gramstolbs.com/lbs-to-grams/): convert pounds to grams and kilograms.

## Guides
- [Baby birth weight](https://gramstolbs.com/guides/baby-weight-grams-to-pounds/): converting a birth weight recorded in grams to pounds and ounces, with a 1000-5000 g table.
- [Gold and troy ounces](https://gramstolbs.com/guides/gold-grams-to-pounds-troy/): why precious metals use troy ounces of 31.1034768 g and what the 9.71 percent error costs.
- [Shipping weight](https://gramstolbs.com/guides/shipping-weight-grams-to-pounds/): converting parcel weight to pounds and where carrier billing brackets fall.
- [Food labels](https://gramstolbs.com/guides/food-label-grams-to-pounds/): converting package and nutrition label weights between grams and pounds.

## Blog
- [Drone Weight: 250 Grams to Pounds for FAA Registration](https://gramstolbs.com/blog/drone-weight-grams-to-pounds/): The FAA draws its drone registration line at 250 grams, which is 0.5512 pounds. Here is that figure and the UK, Canada and Australia thresholds, all converted and sourced.
- [Coffee Bag Sizes in Pounds: 250g, 340g and 1kg Converted](https://gramstolbs.com/blog/coffee-bag-grams-to-pounds/): Every common specialty coffee bag size converted from grams to pounds, from a 250 g bag to a 1 kg bulk bag, plus how to compare price per pound when bag sizes don’t match.
- [Filament Spool Weight: 1kg in Pounds (Net vs Gross)](https://gramstolbs.com/blog/3d-printing-filament-grams-to-pounds/): A 1kg filament spool is 1,000 grams of printable material, or 2.2046 pounds net. The empty spool adds 150 to 260 grams on top, so a full spool weighed on a scale reads higher than the label.
- [Diamond Carats to Grams to Pounds (and Why They Differ)](https://gramstolbs.com/blog/diamond-carats-grams-to-pounds/): A carat is defined as exactly 0.2 grams, which makes it 0.0004 pounds. Here is the full carat-to-gram-to-pound chart, plus what a pound of diamonds would actually mean.

## Key facts
- 1 pound = 453.59237 grams exactly.
- 1 avoirdupois ounce = 28.349523125 grams exactly; 16 ounces make one pound.
- 1 troy ounce = 31.1034768 grams; 12 troy ounces make a troy pound of 373.2417216 grams.
- 500 grams = 1.1023 pounds = 1 lb 1.64 oz.
- 1000 grams = 2.2046 pounds = 2 lb 3.27 oz.
